title: KING ICT - Videos
description:
Welcome to the official channel of KING ICT, a  company specialized in advanced information and communication technology solutions. Here you will find official company announcements, lectures and workshops 

We are part of M SAN Group, which has more than 30 affiliated companies and employs over 1,500 people in six countries. KING ICT is the majority owner of two companies: Aktivis - a company specialized in the development of document management solutions (DMS) and Smart Energy - a company specialized in implementing of measures in the field of energy efficiency.
